title: blazeQOL
description: Minecraft mod for 1.21.11 which features QOL for Blaze Slayer giving you a HUD with general information about the current boss.
body:
Minecraft mod for 1.21.11 which features QOL for Blaze Slayer giving you a HUD with general information about the current boss.

# blazeQOL
## Setup
Use command /display on to enable the features or /display off to disable them.

## Features
A HUD in the middle of the screen showing you name, health and attunement of the Blaze Slayer boss with the indicator whether Twilight Arrow Poison has been used in a range of 8 blocks from the player.

Example: ![Inferno Demonlord IV](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90214cd4b16c0f5bbed296bd29e98684cf28eba6_0.webp)

## Requirements
minecraft version 1.21.11

loader version 0.19.1 (fabric)

fabric api version 0.141.3+1.21.11

### Originally made by Harmfool for 1.8.9
https://github.com/j4yd3nSB/SkyblockSlayerTools
